name: Policy Broker Gate
description: Check the pending tool dispatch against the configured policy floor before allowing execution. Blocks any tool call that violates the policy; aborts the loop on violation. Implements the Olympus policy broker pattern.

inputs.name: tool_calls
inputs.description: Tool calls proposed by the LLM for this iteration

inputs.name: policy_floor_ref
inputs.description: Reference to the policy atom or config that defines allowed tool operations

inputs.name: persona_ref
inputs.description: Active persona; used to resolve persona-specific policy overrides

outputs.name: allowed
outputs.description: True when all proposed tool calls pass the policy floor

outputs.name: blocked_calls
outputs.description: Any tool calls that were blocked by policy

outputs.name: denial_reason
outputs.description: Human-readable explanation when allowed is false
